variant: XGR (combustion engine) / XGRe (Li-ion), 800.1–800.3 with 1–3 hydraulic extensions
name: Befard XGR800 tracked glazing robot
summary: Tracked glass and window manipulator with eight vacuum cups that lifts elements of up to 800 kg to 3.95–5.55 m, driven and operated by radio remote control on rough site ground. Made by Befard in Poland, with a combustion engine (XGR) or Li-ion battery (XGRe).

germany.statusNote: Sold on request by the Polish maker Befard (German-language product page with contact form); Befard names GreenLifter in Fürth as its German sales partner. Befard lists a new XGR800.3 on Maschinensucher.de at a fixed 41,756 € excl. VAT (contact form, no cart).

specs.label: Vertical reach
specs.quote: Ausschübe bis 5,55 m, Funkfernsteuerung für Fahren und Arbeiten serienmäßig.

specs.label: Cup beam functions
specs.value: hydraulic rotation by radio, side shift 10 cm left/right, hydraulic tilting

specs.label: Drive versions
specs.value: XGR combustion engine (optional 230 V mains); XGRe Li-ion battery

specs.label: Control
specs.value: radio remote control for driving and working
specs.quote: Funkfernsteuerung für Fahren und Arbeiten serienmäßig

notes: Crawler undercarriage; maker says it works on soft, uneven ground with sand, mud or rubble (roughGround is a maker claim).
Operator-controlled by radio remote; not autonomous.
Options include hook, forks, LED light, overload protection and free RAL colour.
